title: Automata from Agent Traces: Failure and Next-Step Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.23670v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based agents execute multi-step tasks, but their behavioral structure remains opaque: long unstructured traces resist the safety auditing and runtime monitoring that deployment requires. Existing approaches operate per-trace or success-only, so they miss the cross-run topology that links next-step and failure prediction. To recover that shared structure, we collapse an entire trace corpus into a single, compact finite-state machine (FSM) that serves as a structural substrate for the otherwise unpredictable behavior of LLM agents. Across twelve public datasets, the FSMs are compact (7-43 states), replay held-out data at >=0.997 fitness with near-identical topology across splits, and build in milliseconds. This substrate addresses both prediction goals. For next-step prediction, FSM-state context outperforms Agent Workflow Memory on every ground-truth-matched dataset. For failure prediction, per-state behavioral features reach held-out

translated_title: 从智能体轨迹中提取自动机：失败预测与下一步预测
translated_abstract: 基于大型语言模型的智能体执行多步任务，但其行为结构仍不透明：长而无结构的轨迹阻碍了部署所需的安全审计和运行时监控。现有方法仅针对单条轨迹或仅关注成功案例，因此忽略了连接下一步预测和失败预测的跨运行拓扑结构。为恢复这种共享结构，我们将整个轨迹语料库压缩为单个紧凑的有限状态机（FSM），作为LLM智能体行为预测的结构基础。在十二个公开数据集上，FSM紧凑（7-43个状态），对保留数据的重放适应度≥0.997，跨分割拓扑几乎一致，且构建时间仅需毫秒级。该结构基础解决了两个预测目标：对于下一步预测，FSM状态上下文在所有真实匹配数据集上优于智能体工作流记忆；对于失败预测，每状态行为特征在保留数据上达到...
tldr: 本文提出将LLM智能体的轨迹语料库压缩为紧凑有限状态机，以统一支持下一步预测和失败预测，在多个数据集上表现出高适应度和优越性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes compressing LLM agent trace corpora into a compact finite-state machine to jointly support next-step and failure prediction, achieving high fitness and superior performance across multiple datasets.
